title: QA run · release-18.4.0-w1-upgrade (3/3) · ff04ad81 · 2026-11-10 · 2 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

Runner `session_012dn2AeZBJi8E3ThLDzKDg5` (cloud, effort high), dispatched by `qa#2` (#32023) as round 1, slice R2: an early probe of the 18.4.0 release wave on the maintainer's word 「开跑」. The seat posts this record through the relay. The seat cross-checked the clause-5 mechanism against the subject's source: `backfillActivationLedgerPackages` binds each package-less row with no peer check, and the boot catch logs the generic "did not finish".

## Environment fingerprint

- **Subject:** framework `ff04ad811da54166a5d1114fade5a1a6ab99138c` (main, 2026-11-10), detached. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli...` (64 tasks) and the dogfood closure. No console build: no item is browser-surface.
- **App under test:** a blank scaffold written by npm `create-objectstack@18.3.0`, run with `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0`. Package `com.example.app183` (namespace `app183`) declares:
  - flows `app183_digest` (schedule, 60 s), `app183_note_approval` (record-after-create on `app183_note`, approver `queue:app183_reviewers`) and `app183_switch` (autolaunched);
  - permission set `app183_note_editor`, sharing rule `app183_share_notes`, queue `app183_reviewers`;
  - `requires: ['automation','triggers','approvals']`.

  `packages:` adds `com.example.qaa` (`qa_a`) and `com.example.qab` (`qa_b`), each declaring a queue `qa_desk`. The subject runs the same project with its `@objectstack/*` dependencies linked to this tree and the tree's `objectstack` binary.
- **18.3.0 database, route (a), real upgrade evidence.** Rows came through 18.3.0's own doors unless marked *by SQL*.
  1. 18.3.0 boot: `objectstack dev --no-watch --seed-admin -p 4710 -d file:/tmp/qa183/db/v183.db`, and a second boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=true` so the schedule trigger arms. A dev file DB is two files: `v183.db` and `v183.telemetry.db`, the latter holding `sys_automation_run`, `sys_flow_dispatch` and `sys_audit_log`.
  2. As admin:
     - a member `member@qa.test`, granted `app183_note_editor`;
     - a `sys_queue_member` on `qa_desk`;
     - an `app183_note` leaving a pending `sys_approval_request` (`flow:app183_note_approval`) and a paused run;
     - three `sys_metadata_activation` rows from the 18.3.0 toggle doors (flow `app183_switch` off, position `org_member` off, queue `qa_desk` off);
     - `sys_flow_dispatch` rows `schedule:app183_digest:2026-11-10T07:02/03/04Z` written by the 18.3.0 schedule trigger.
  3. By SQL, with 18.3.0 stopped:
     - `UPDATE sys_metadata_activation SET package_id=NULL` (18.3.0 had written the package, the first holder for the two-holder queue);
     - a managed `sys_sharing_rule` row and a `sys_email_template` overlay `auth.password_reset` (18.3.0 has no writer for either, ADR-0131 D2, D6, D10);
     - a 70-day-old dispatch key `schedule:app183_digest:2026-09-01T07:00Z`;
     - a WAL checkpoint.

     Golden copy sha256: `v183.db` `1aac5027…`, `v183.telemetry.db` `3792581d…`.
  4. Leg copies:
     - conflict copy: golden, `DROP INDEX uniq_sys_metadata_activation_metadata_type_name`, plus a second package-less row `(flow, app183_switch, NULL, active=1)`;
     - environment-item copy: an environment-authored flow `env_switch` saved through 18.3.0's `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/env_switch`; its ledger row `(flow, env_switch, NULL, 0)` inserted by SQL, because 18.3.0's toggle answers 409.
- **Ports and DBs:** each leg had its own port (4710–4712 on 18.3.0; 4721–4729 item 1; 4731–4732 item 2; 4741 item 3; 4733 probes) and its own copy of both files.
- **Seed and auth:** `--seed-admin`. Fixed auth secret across boots. Subject boots ran with scheduled work off.
- **Time:** 2026-11-10 06:54:45Z → 07:21:30Z. One runner, sequential.

## Scope

- Selector `release-18.4.0-w1-upgrade`, 3 items, each `revision: 1`. **Definitions read from PR #32035 at `fb170357`** (epic #32022, M1). They are not on main at the subject sha.
  - `platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade` (P1, mixed)
  - `platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade` (P1, mixed)
  - `cli.migrate-stored-references` (P1, cli)
- No planned items.

## Per-clause verdicts

Environment leg (4728): `flow env_switch` stays NULL, `updated_at` unchanged. |

After one boot: `replace_unique_index` under Safe. `os migrate apply --yes`: `Applied 1 change(s)`. Plan again: `Physical schema is in sync with metadata — nothing to migrate.` With the item's literal order (two boots, then plan), boot 2 already logs `[schema-drift] auto-reconciled replace_unique_index …`, so the plan has nothing to show (reproduced on a second copy). |

The same boot's backfill binds one of the two rows to `com.example.app183`, then WARN `package backfill did not finish … Duplicate record refused`. Boot 2 with no row deleted: no refusal, the index is built, and two rows remain for one flow, `(com.example.app183, 0)` and `(NULL, 1)`. Reproduced on three fresh copies. The 2026-09-01 key has no copy; its bare row stays. |

The bodies differ only by release-wide additions (`restore` and `purge` in `apiOperations`, entries `sys_activity` and `sys_comment`). A fresh install of the same release with the same grant and position switch (4732) answers a body identical to the upgraded one, ids removed. |

One finding: R6 `sys_queue_member` `queue` `qa_desk`, reason `ambiguous`, candidates `qa_a/qa_desk` (`com.example.qaa`) and `qa_b/qa_desk` (`com.example.qab`). Row dump and `v183.db` sha unchanged. |

Rows, audit and dispatch counts unchanged. |

Automation pins (rule 6; none boots a file 18.3.0 wrote, so the live legs above are new evidence): `packages/qa/dogfood/test/activation-ledger-package-key.dogfood.test.ts`, `stored-reference-package-column.dogfood.test.ts`, `automation-stored-reference-package-column.dogfood.test.ts` (20 passed, 1 skipped by the memory-driver `skipIf`); `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` (9/9).

## Reproduction rule — platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade · clause 5

1. On a copy of an 18.3.0-written SQLite file whose boot on this tree finds a packaged flow `app183_switch` (package `com.example.app183`) with a ledger row:
   - `DROP INDEX uniq_sys_metadata_activation_metadata_type_name;`
   - `INSERT INTO sys_metadata_activation (id, created_at, updated_at, metadata_type, name, package_id, active) VALUES ('qa_dup_switch', …, 'flow', 'app183_switch', NULL, 1);`
   - optionally a later package-less row `('qa_later_digest', …, 'flow', 'app183_digest', NULL, 0)`.
2. `objectstack dev --no-watch --seed-admin -p 4727 -d file:COPY`. ERROR `cannot build 'uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless' … held by 2 rows …`, then WARN `… package backfill did not finish … Duplicate record refused`. Stop and read: the first-stored `app183_switch` row now names `com.example.app183`, the other is NULL, and `app183_digest` is NULL.
3. Boot again without deleting any row.
   - **Expected:** the refusal repeats until an operator deletes one row; no row is bound while the pair stands.
   - **Actual:** no refusal line; `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless` exists; both rows remain; `POST /api/v1/automation/app183_switch/trigger` as admin answers `409 FLOW_DISABLED`, decided by the first-stored row; `app183_digest` stays NULL on boots 2 and 3, with only the generic "did not finish" WARN.

Reproduced three times on fresh copies through the server's own boot.

## Derived item verdicts

- `platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade`: **fail** (clauses 1–4 pass, clause 5 fails).
- `platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade`: **pass**.
- `cli.migrate-stored-references`: **pass**.

## Fixture gaps

- Planted by SQL because 18.3.0 has no door for them: the managed `sys_sharing_rule` row, the `sys_email_template` overlay, an environment-item ledger row, two package-less ledger rows for one name, and a dispatch key older than 30 days.
- Not planted: `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` (R3), `sys_flow_credential` (R9), `sys_connector_connection` (R11), `sys_assignment_cursor` (R13). The backfill item's title names them; its acceptance does not.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

About 6 min on the same boots and copies. Doors: `os migrate plan` and `os migrate stored-references` on an 18.3.0 file before its first boot on this release; bind boundaries (unknown id, empty package, unknown and non-reference tables, the address form), all exit 1 and write nothing; the activation door on a two-holder queue (409 naming both candidates), an unknown queue (404). Personas: operator (CLI) and admin. Found: two product defects beside the clauses, extracted below.

Observations, not filed:
- Without `--dev` (or `NODE_ENV=development`), `migrate plan` and `apply` on a dev DB plan the telemetry tables into the primary file. That is the documented production posture (`packages/cli/src/utils/telemetry-datasource.ts`).
- Bind takes only the package id; the address form the report prints is refused with a "the report may be stale" hint.
- No package-qualified activation door exists for an ambiguous package-less ledger row, and bind does not cover `sys_metadata_activation`. This comes from the fixture: 18.3.0 itself writes the first holder's package.

Security: none found, none withheld. Rule 7 (independent verify pass) was not run.

## Wall clock

About 27 min: environment about 11 min (protocol read, install, CLI closure build, the 18.3.0 scaffold and two boots, plants, golden copy), testing about 16 min.
